summary: The Danish Maritime Fund provides seed funding and financial support to Danish maritime startups, scaleups, and innovation projects focused on maritime entrepreneurship and innovation, green transition, maritime safety, and digitalization. It supports projects in early phases with grants and loans, encouraging collaboration among companies, educational institutions, and universities to develop the future maritime sector and workforce.
eligible_applicants: Companies collaborating with educational institutions and universities

deadlines.application_deadline: Varies by funding round; refer to specific application dates at https://dendanskemaritimefond.dk/for-ansoegere/ansoegningsfrister/
deadlines.decided_at: Varies per project announcement typically within months after application deadline

reporting_requirements: Project progress reports as required by grant terms
Business plan with market potential, go-to-market strategy, and expectations
Loan repayment reports if loans are part of funding
